questions.q: How does a diesel engine ignite its fuel?
choices: hot compressed air ignites the injected diesel
why: No — that is a petrol engine; diesels use compression ignition.
Correct! Air is compressed until hot enough to ignite the injected diesel.
No — sunlight has nothing to do with engine combustion.

questions.q: What are the two big DOWNSIDES of running a generator?
why: No — the opposite: a diesel generator is loud and emits fumes.
Correct! It is noisy (~85–100 dB) and its exhaust pollutes the air (CO₂, NOx, soot).
No — it runs any time it has fuel; that is not a downside.
